messages.text:
KOSPI to open higher after US markets gain led by hopes on Anthropic IPO (SPX +0.7%). TECH to lead the markets tracking SOX +2.8%, yet upside limited ahead of SK HYNIX 3Q earnings tmrw (eyes on shareholder return), and FOMC rate decision on Thur (cons unchd).

* 3Q TODAY: ISC (10:30), HANWHA OCEAN, SHINHAN FIN, ST PHARM, HD HYUNDAI ELEC, LG INNOTEK (14:00), HANWHA SYSTEMS (15:30), POSCO ITNL, POSOC HLDG (16:00), HANMI PHARM (16:30), JB FIN (17:00)
* TECH: 1) Anthropic files for IPO in global race to raise cash for AI, 2) Broadcom arranges $63bn deal to finance Anthropic's chips, 3) SpaceX agrees to $40bn chip-financing deal with Apollo, 3) SEC (005930) and SK HYNIX (000660) set to mass produce 8-layer HBM4 for Nvidia in 2Q27.
* SK HYNIX (000660) reportedly plans to announce an add'l shareholder return package worth up to W60tn (c.$42bn) on 3Q earnings tmrw.
* SEC (005930)'s avg HBM quote price is at $4.5 per Gb, 25% higher than Micron ($4) and SK HYNIX (000660) ($3.6-3.8), press.
* HMC (005380) finalizes supply chain for humanoid robot "Atlas", including HD MOBIS (012330) for actuators, SDI (006400)/LG ES (373220) for batteries, and HD MOBIS (012330)/NAMUGA (190510)/MCNEX (097520))/CAMSYS (050110) for cameras.
* JYP ENTER (035900) Japanese NEXROC Group and SVCV are reportedly reviewing procedures to acquire 25-50% stake in the co, aiming to launch a tender offer on Nov 20; co denied the news.
* ROBOT: Toyota is driving an investment and restructuring to become global robot leader, planning to deploy 400k robots w/an annual budget of $6.4bn for plant automation.
